name: @mark1russell7/ste-lint
description: A linter for the writing rules of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English in Markdown, MDX and TypeScript doc comments

shared-ci.off: The ruleset of main requires the check ci. A call of the shared CI gives other check names, and only the owner changes the ruleset.

no-build-output.off: Git keeps dist/, because other repositories install this package from git, and a git dependency needs no build at install. CI checks that dist/ agrees with src/.

typed-scripts.reason: dist/ is the build output of src/, which is TypeScript. site/check-probe.js uses the global helpers of the site check of site-pages, and this repository has no type declarations for them yet.
